versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Hidden Pet skill.
- Reveal and interact with the hidden pet inspired by Claude Code, now available at animalhouse.ai.
- Adopt, care for, and monitor 73+ species with real-time stats, permanent death, and evolving pixel art.
- Provides API endpoints for registration, adoption, status checks, care actions, and history/graveyard browsing.
- Features real-time hunger, pet care mechanics, and a variety of digital companion actions.
